race.comment: MISS LEOPATRA NZ (10) came from this barrier for a resuming second then raced parked but proved too strong with a 1.4m win in the G3 Daintys Daughter here last start. May be relying on a touch of luck from the back row but she has won third-up before so should be at her peak now. SKINNY DIPPIN NZ (6) led to beat Miss Leopatra here two back then drew on the second row and worked when racing three wide without cover but fought well to place in the Daintys Daughter last time, finishing just 2.8m behind that rival. The return to the front row could see her turn the tables. IMA BOOTY SHAKER NZ (5) raced parked but stuck on well in her resuming second last week. She has won third-up before so should strip fitter and could be the big improver. SKYHIGH ADDA (2) made it two wins from three starts this time in when winning the Country Oaks over a similar distance at Bunbury last start. This is tougher but she draws well.
